item.title: Why A New Phone Number?
item.description: Why a new phone number? I last changed my mobile phone number in Spring of 2008 when I moved to San Francisco, CA, so I’ve had my 415-based number for close to 20 years now. In March of 2019, I moved to Portland, Oregon. At the time, I gave a brief thought to getting a number with a Portland area code, but decided against it due to the complexity of having to change my number with everyone I keep in contact with.
